title: Cost attribution by label, by project and by folder

videos.script: The bill arrives. Whose money was it? {{whose}} A bill can be cut three ways. By project, which environment spent it. By folder, which part of the organisation. By label, which team, wherever it ran. {{cuts}} Labels only work if they are there, and only from the day they were added. {{labels}} You will query a month of the shop's billing export, flattened into a small database on your own computer. {{query}} Then the line that matters most. More than a fifth of the bill carries no label at all. Inside it: an idle machine, a forgotten disk, a sandbox, and the logs everyone shares. {{nobody}}
